pages.title: Sketchtone
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Turn a drawing into a composition in Sketchtone. Sketch lines or dots, choose among eight instruments, and press Play to hear the resulting sequence. Layer sounds and experiment with echo to change the music produced by the shapes on the canvas.

pages.title: Monsters Wheels 2
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Take monster trucks through varied events in Monsters Wheels 2. Race rivals, crush parked cars, perform flips, or beat a countdown across twenty-four levels. Tilt in the air and use nitro while traveling through jungle, beach, amusement-park, and desert settings.

pages.title: Rift Fighter
pages.creator: LittleOrbit
pages.description: Fight with typed techniques in Rift Fighter. Move through enemy hordes and enter keyboard sequences to perform attacks, beginning with the J-then-K charge. Collect manuals from stronger foes to learn more moves and combine the techniques during later survival encounters.

pages.title: Fishing Dog
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Guide a swinging hook toward fish in Fishing Dog. Tap to change its direction and line up the next catch without hitting the side walls. Gather the letters in CHANCE to improve the odds of finding a rare fish during the fishing attempt.

pages.title: Jump to the Mountain for the Brainrots
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Climb to guarded collectibles in Jump to the Mountain for the Brainrots. Move Obby up the mountain, avoid the enemies, and pick up the characters you want to rescue. Sell collected Brainrots to improve jump height and reach higher parts of the collection.

pages.title: Romantic K-Pop Transformation
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create three stage-inspired makeovers in Romantic K-Pop Transformation. Choose makeup, hairstyles, hair colors, and clothing for the heroines, building looks from gentle to more dramatic. Finish the outfits and save the completed images before trying another combination.

pages.title: Red Stickman vs Monster School
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Fight through armed platform stages in Red Stickman vs Monster School. Collect different weapons and clear the monsters blocking the route. Work through sixty levels and confront ten bosses while guiding the red stick figure through the school's combat challenges.

pages.title: Ballerina Cappuccina First Date
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare two characters for an evening together in Ballerina Cappuccina First Date. Choose clothing and finishing details for Cappuccina and Tung Tung Sahur, comparing pieces for both outfits. Complete their coordinated looks before the pair leave for their first date.

pages.title: Racing Game King HP
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Choose a driving format in Racing Game King HP. Compete in circuit, sprint, knockout, or time-attack races, using nitro when another burst of speed is needed. Change the camera, brake for difficult turns, and restore the car's position if it becomes stuck.

pages.title: Bubble Escape
pages.creator: OwlMaGames
pages.description: Guide floating groups to safety in Bubble Escape. Move the bubbles toward the exit without letting them touch spikes, accounting for their wobbling motion. Complete thirty levels and save more bubbles during each attempt to increase the score.

pages.title: Falling Blocks Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Arrange descending shapes in Falling Blocks Puzzle. Move or rotate each piece to complete horizontal rows, clearing them from the board for points. Use a fast drop when the position is ready and keep the stack from reaching the top of the screen.

pages.title: Sniper 3D Zombie
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Locate concealed undead in Sniper 3D Zombie. Search the surroundings for enemies that blend into the scene, then aim the rifle and fire. Keep the defended position secure while finding more targets and improving the score on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Among Squid Challenge Online
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Hunt through a maze in Among Squid Challenge Online. Move between passages, catch other players, and use the knife to eliminate them. Hide in ventilation openings if threatened and check the map while working toward removing every opponent from the field.

pages.title: Wild Tanks
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Develop an armored vehicle in Wild Tanks. Choose a survival race or a tank battle, earning stars and improving the tanker's level as you play. Upgrade the machine and drive across rough terrain while attacking the enemies encountered along the route.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pop
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Clear colored clusters in Bubble Shooter Pop. Aim bubbles toward matching pieces and remove groups from the arrangement, checking the angle before each shot. Open more of the board as clusters disappear and look for another useful target to clear.

pages.title: Join Clash Color Button
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Choose a safe passage for a group in Join Clash Color Button. Select doors that advance the team toward the end, accounting for the different enemies or challenges behind them. Guide the group past traps and obstacles while keeping the escape route open.

pages.title: Caillou Chef
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Manage a small cafe in Caillou Chef. Prepare coffees and pancakes for the arriving customers, choosing the next order to handle before their patience runs out. Keep the service moving by balancing preparation with delivery of the finished food and drinks.

pages.title: Strike Breakout
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Carry out ten rescue assignments in Strike Breakout. Enter hostile areas with a helicopter-supported team and fight to free the President and security officers. Aim through the scope, switch firearms, and use the interaction control to pick up equipment or rescue captives.

pages.title: Glossy Bubbles Challenge
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Bounce shots into colored clusters in Glossy Bubbles Challenge. Aim at matching bubbles to clear them, using the walls when a rebound provides a better route. Plan each shot around the remaining arrangement while working toward a higher score.

pages.title: Evermatch
pages.creator: Broccoli Games
pages.description: Travel through matching boards in Evermatch. Swap gems into lines of at least three, creating special pieces through larger combinations such as lightning or bombs. Complete levels to unlock locations and landmarks inspired by countries around the world.

pages.title: Cameraman vs Toilets Puzzle
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Clear targets without harming allies in Cameraman vs Toilets Puzzle. Hold to aim and release a shot at the hostile toilets carrying character heads. Destroy every required enemy while keeping the agent and friendly character safe from the shooting sequence.

pages.title: Cat vs Kripotians
pages.creator: Dextery games
pages.description: Help Kitty fight an invading force in Cat vs Kripotians. Move through enemies and traps, jump between sections, and switch weapons when another attack is useful. Work toward each level's end alongside the mysterious green ally, including missions with time limits.

pages.title: Maze Hide Or Seek
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Take either side of a maze pursuit in Maze Hide Or Seek. As a hunter, track down everyone in the field; as a villager, activate switches and escape. Use the maze's passages to approach a target or stay away from the opposing side.

pages.title: Arrow Hit
pages.creator: Indie developer
pages.description: Shoot at spinning targets in Arrow Hit. Click to launch an arrow when a clear section rotates into line, spacing hits around the target. Watch the changing rotation before releasing the next shot and continue through the archery stages.

pages.title: The Patagonians
pages.creator: RDV Indie Games
pages.description: Search for a missing child in The Patagonians. Explore an abandoned mansion after the protagonist's daughter disappears on her birthday, solving riddles and confronting monsters along the way. Use movement, jumps, interactions, and weapons to continue through the horror-themed adventure.

pages.title: Merge Archer Defense
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Protect a stronghold in Merge Archer Defense. Combine archers into stronger units and build a team capable of stopping the opposing army. Aim the volleys with swipe controls and keep developing the formation as the castle-defense battles continue.

pages.title: Tank Online
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: Take an armored vehicle into multiplayer fights in Tank Online. Move with the directional keys and aim the cannon with the mouse to fire at rival players. Use the battlefield's positions to seek a useful shot during the tank battle.

pages.title: Solitaire Garden
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Restore an inherited property in Solitaire Garden. Clear TriPeaks layouts by selecting cards one rank above or below the discard card, drawing from the stock when needed. Earn stars across more than eight hundred levels and spend them on the mansion and garden.

pages.title: Banana Cat Escape
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Reunite a disguised feline with its companion in Banana Cat Escape. Guide the cat through puzzle layouts and reach the finish without entering an enemy's view. Use the movement controls to find a safe route around the guards and complete each escape.

pages.title: Zomblox.io
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description: Survive together in Zomblox.io. Fight successive zombie waves with friends and break loot boxes to find stronger weapons. Move, jump, and collect guns with the interaction key while keeping the group alive through another round of undead attacks.

pages.title: Slime Farm
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Develop a ranch of creatures in Slime Farm. Tap the production field to speed up activity and swipe trucks to increase sales. Spend progress on improvements and new levels while working toward unlocking the full collection of baby slimes.

pages.title: Roller Ball Adventure
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Cross a dangerous factory in Roller Ball Adventure. Roll and jump with the red ball, defeat enemies, and stay clear of laser beams along the route. Gather the required yellow stars while progressing through a hundred levels against the planet-squaring minions.

pages.title: Get Lucky
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect outfit items during a run in Get Lucky. Drag the character toward coat hangers to charge the progress bar into its red target area. Avoid the red blankets that interfere with the collection and finish the current stage with the required charge.

pages.title: Noob Torch Flip 2D
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Flip a carried light between objects in Noob Torch Flip 2D. Tap at the right time to make the torch jump or perform a double flip. Cross elevators, minecarts, trees, and other parts of the environment while continuing through different biomes.

pages.title: Paint Shooter
pages.creator: VodoGame
pages.description: Cover white objects with color in Paint Shooter. Aim and fire at the three-dimensional shapes, coloring and bursting the groups needed to complete the stage. Work through more than a hundred levels while finding a route for the next paint shot.

pages.title: Noob Escape: one level again
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Break out of prison in Noob Escape: one level again. Guide Noob through a hundred escape stages, working past the obstacles that block each route. Continue toward the final confrontation with Cheater and the boss battle at the end of the jailbreak.

pages.title: Wood Block Puzzle
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Fit wooden shapes into complete lines in Wood Block Puzzle. Place pieces to fill horizontal or vertical rows, clearing occupied cells and adding points. Preserve room for future shapes because the run ends when another block can no longer fit.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire 2 Suits
pages.creator: Tomasz Maciej
pages.description: Clear two-suit layouts in Spider Solitaire 2 Suits. Build eight descending sequences from king to ace, removing each completed same-suit run automatically. Move card groups to uncover hidden pieces and deal from the stock when the tableau needs another set of cards.

pages.title: Pou
pages.creator: Zakeh Limited
pages.description: Look after a virtual pet in Pou. Feed and clean the character, play activities to earn coins, and watch it grow while gaining levels. Choose outfits and other customization options as the pet's daily care and minigames continue.

pages.title: Idle Craft 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Rebuild after a destructive meteor shower in Idle Craft 3D. Hire workers to clear the land and restore the house, checking on laborers who fall asleep from exhaustion. Bring in elders to wake them and keep the reconstruction moving through its next stage.

pages.title: Arkadium's Bridge
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Partner with the computer in Arkadium's Bridge. Bid and play card hands against two AI opponents, coordinating tricks with the computerized teammate. Work toward fulfilling the partnership's contract through the game's online version of the classic four-player card contest.

pages.title: 2048 Drag 'n drop
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Place numbered tiles into matching positions in 2048 Drag 'n drop. Drag a piece toward an equal value to combine them into a larger number. Keep building successive merges while working toward producing the 2048 tile.

pages.title: Vector Venom
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Cross a retro course with wall-mounted webs in Vector Venom. Move and jump through the route, firing the hookshot to swing or pull between surfaces. Work around the obstacles ahead as Venom continues from one wall section to the next.

pages.title: Candy Crusher
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Match sweets within a move limit in Candy Crusher. Clear groups of at least three identical candies, forming four- or five-piece combinations to create bonus candies. Score efficiently with the available moves and level up to unlock additional space on the board.

pages.title: Kick The Zombie
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Experiment with attacks on an undead target in Kick The Zombie. Tap to kick the character or drag to toss it, using the available weapons during the clicker activity. Try different actions against the neighborhood zombie and continue the destruction-themed session.

pages.title: Mechanic Max
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Repair and restyle vehicles in Mechanic Max. Clean a damaged car and work through the garage activities to restore its condition. Change the finished vehicle into looks inspired by racers, taxis, emergency vehicles, vintage cars, or other available designs.

pages.title: Sniper Trigger
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Complete target assignments in Sniper Trigger. Use the rifle to line up enemies from a distance and eliminate the targets required by the stage. Check their positions before firing as later levels present a different arrangement of opponents.

pages.title: Dino Hunter: Killing Strand
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Face prehistoric threats in Dino Hunter: Killing Strand. Move through combat with firearms, grenades, and different aiming positions, switching between first-person and third-person camera views. Reload and use cover or movement as the dinosaur-shooting encounters continue.

pages.title: Super Sniper
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Clear red stick figures from each stage in Super Sniper. Aim the rifle at enemies who may be moving or hidden within the scene. Locate all required targets and make accurate shots to complete the current assassination assignment.

pages.title: Sumo Push Push
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Contest narrow lanes in Sumo Push Push. Tap a lane to launch a sumo wrestler, choosing weight classes that can overpower the opposing formation. Balance attacks and defense against a real-time rival while working to control the lanes.

pages.title: Batty Math
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Translate letters into place values in Batty Math. Use B, A, and T from the word BAT to interpret the numerical puzzles, then select the correct answer. Check how each letter's position affects the represented value before choosing the result.

pages.title: Dolls Couples Puzzle
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Rebuild paired-character pictures in Dolls Couples Puzzle. Choose one of six images and select a difficulty mode, then drag its scattered pieces into place. Match the dolls' outlines and background details until the selected couple's picture is complete.

pages.title: X Racer SciFi
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Pilot a rocket between barriers in X Racer. Move left or right to avoid walls and collect power-ups that provide different temporary abilities. Keep the craft clear of crashes while extending the run and pursuing a stronger high score.

pages.title: Zombie Armaggeddon
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Command an undead invasion in Zombie Armaggeddon. Tap the zombie icons to summon attackers into the city and send them after its inhabitants. Continue adding creatures to the nighttime assault as you work toward overwhelming the remaining citizens.

pages.title: Cartoon Stunt Car
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Complete stunt courses in Cartoon Stunt Car. Drive alone or alongside a second player, using nitro and controlled turns to reach the end of each level. Unlock the nine sports cars through completed stages and restart a course when another approach is needed.

pages.title: Cute Dodo Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Put together extinct-bird scenes in Cute Dodo Jigsaw. Select one of twelve pictures and a layout with twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces. Reconnect the scattered image sections until the chosen dodo illustration is restored.

pages.title: Digital Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore futuristic vehicle pictures in Digital Cars Slide. Choose one of three images and a puzzle mode, then slide the scrambled sections into their correct positions. Compare neighboring details to determine which piece should enter the empty space next.

pages.title: Flying rabbit
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Gather seasonal treats in Flying rabbit. Use the mouse or touch controls to guide the Easter bunny through the air and collect eggs along the way. Keep finding more eggs during the flight to improve the score of the attempt.

pages.title: Jelly Shift Online
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Reshape a moving block in Jelly Shift Online. Adjust the jelly's dimensions to fit the openings formed by approaching obstacles. Read the next gap before changing its size so the character can continue through the course without getting stuck against a barrier.

pages.title: Hyper Memory Food Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Find food-picture pairs in Hyper Memory Food Party. Reveal two cards and compare them, remembering their locations when they do not match. Clear all identical pairs to complete the layout as later levels introduce more demanding memory arrangements.

pages.title: Baby Cleaning
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Prepare a room for its young occupant in Baby Cleaning. Follow the prompts to clean and organize the space, selecting the items needed for each task. Complete the activities across multiple levels to leave the baby's surroundings tidied up.

pages.title: Cargo Truck Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Carry freight through driving levels in Cargo Truck Simulator. Control the truck with the movement keys and follow the route through town and forest settings. Keep the load moving toward the destination to complete the delivery and unlock further stages.

pages.title: Speed For Beat
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Compete through different racing formats in Speed For Beat. Choose a mode or tournament and take the car onto its course against other drivers. Use the arrow keys to handle the turns and continue working toward a leading finish.

pages.title: Gummy Blocks Evolution
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Clear a colorful grid in Gummy Blocks Evolution. Drag pieces into place to complete rows or columns, removing the filled lines and making space. Finish at least two lines together to gain a useful power-up for the next arrangement.

pages.title: Water Slide Car Race
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take a car onto the water in Water Slide Car Race. Steer it like a boat through the race, managing speed and braking as the route changes. Compete toward the finish while keeping the floating vehicle under control across the open water.

pages.title: Gun Flipper
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Propel a rotating weapon through the air in Gun Flipper. Time each shot so its recoil sends the gun toward gold coins, keeping track of the limited ammunition. Collect more coins while managing the weapon's changing angle between shots.

pages.title: Jelly Blast Online
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Create matches in Jelly Blast Online. Swap neighboring tiles to form a horizontal or vertical line of at least three candies of one color. Remove those pieces and inspect the new arrangement for another combination that advances the puzzle.

pages.title: Cartoon Trucks Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Search illustrated vehicles in Cartoon Trucks Hidden Stars. Inspect the truck picture and select every concealed star to unlock the next level. There is no countdown, giving you time to examine the drawing's details before choosing another hiding place.

pages.title: Wave 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Control a small craft's height in Wave 2. Hold to rise and release to descend, steering through obstacles and passing rings for points. Collect coins along the route to unlock additional spacecraft for later flights through the wave-shaped course.

pages.title: Become a Puppy Groomer
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Look after animals in Become a Puppy Groomer. Use the available grooming instruments to work through the pets' care activities and improve their appearance. Meet the different visitors and complete each session before moving to the next animal needing attention.

pages.title: Garden Design
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Grow a backyard plot in Garden Design. Clear the area, plant seeds, water the plants, and harvest the produce as the garden develops. Add decorations around the working space to bring the planting and design activities together.

pages.title: Bingo Revealer
pages.creator: TurboNuke
pages.description: Mark called numbers on a card in Bingo Revealer. Complete bingo patterns to win rounds and unlock pictures from the collection. Keep checking the sheet as new numbers arrive and work toward revealing another image through successful bingo play.

pages.title: Smash Your PC
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Break an on-screen machine in Smash Your PC. Click the computer to attack it and continue the destruction-themed activity. Try repeated hits and the available interactions to change the state of the target during the game.

pages.title: Babysitter: Crazy Daycare
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Help a family take a break in Babysitter: Crazy Daycare. Look after the babies and respond to the care tasks presented around the room. Select the items needed to keep the children attended to while working through the daycare activities.

pages.title: Pro Wrestling Action
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fight to remain inside the ring in Pro Wrestling Action. Punch, kick, and knock out opponents before throwing them over the ropes. Climb for a timed diving attack and collect coins to improve the selected wrestler between bouts.

pages.title: Tight And Bright Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare two friends for a colorful event in Tight And Bright Party. Choose outfits for Vincy and Princy, comparing the shades and clothing styles available in their wardrobes. Complete their accessories and coordinated looks before the party begins.

pages.title: Anime Dress Up
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Design a stylized character in Anime Dress Up. Choose among the clothing, appearance options, unusual accessories, and cat details to build a new look. Use the random option for another combination or capture the finished design with the screenshot button.

pages.title: Pharaoh House Hidden Object
pages.creator: Yolkgames
pages.description: Search a detailed scene in Pharaoh House Hidden Object. Locate the requested items before time expires, earning a hundred points for each correct selection. Incorrect clicks cost fifty points, so inspect the picture carefully before marking another possible object.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Funny Animals
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Assemble a humorous wildlife collection in Jigsaw Puzzle Funny Animals. Choose among sixteen animal pictures and reconnect their scattered sections. Match the outlines and scene details to finish the selected image before beginning another jigsaw from the collection.

pages.title: Neon Battle Tank
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Defend a headquarters in Neon Battle Tank. Steer the tank around the battlefield and fire at enemy vehicles attacking the position. Keep both the controlled tank and its base safe as more opposing machines enter the fight.

pages.title: Stranger Things Christmas Party
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style a television-inspired group in Stranger Things Christmas Party. Help Eleven, Will, and their friends prepare for the celebration by choosing festive clothing and other outfit details. Complete the group's looks before their unusual Christmas gathering begins.

pages.title: Jenner Sisters Spooky Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create dramatic salon looks in Jenner Sisters Spooky Hairstyles. Assist the game's version of Kanye West as he styles the sisters' hair for Halloween. Work through the hairdressing choices and finish the unusual hairstyles that complement their costumes.

pages.title: Animal Olympics - Weight Lifting
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Compete as a strong bull in Animal Olympics - Weight Lifting. Click the appearing muscle dots to fill the power gauge and raise the barbell. Choose the next weight between attempts and aim for the heaviest successful lift within three tries.

pages.title: K-On Dress Up
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Prepare performers for an event in K-On Dress Up. Browse the available clothing and choose looks for the girls before their upcoming show. Coordinate the selected outfits and finishing details to complete their stage-ready appearances.

pages.title: Medieval Church Escape 2 Episode 2
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Find another route out in Medieval Church Escape 2 Episode 2. Search the church's rooms, collect useful items, and inspect clues around the scene. Combine the discoveries through the inventory puzzles to open the way past the barriers preventing an escape.
